test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_sum_decimal (d32 Decimal32(2), d64 Decimal64(4), nd64 Nullable(Decimal64(4)), nd128 Nullable(Decimal128(6)), flag UInt8) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_sum_decimal SELECT toDecimal32(intHash32(number) % 1000000, 2), toDecimal64(intHash64(number) % 1000000000000, 4), if(intHash32(number) % 5 = 0, NULL, toDecimal64(intHash64(number) % 1000000000000, 4)), if(intHash32(number) % 5 = 0, NULL, toDecimal128(intHash64(number), 6)), intHash32(number + 1) % 2 FROM numbers_mt(50000000)

SELECT sumIf(d64, flag) FROM t_sum_decimal FORMAT Null
